summary: Read desired declarations, selected declaration tokens and cheap actual summaries together with fractal subject desired --json [--all | SUBJECT...] [--kind K]. The batch API reads one store snapshot without status reduction or card folds.

replay.detail: No graph replay or new projection.

schema.detail: Adds POST /v1/desired/batch with subjects (default empty, meaning all) and optional kind. The JSON array flattens DesiredSubject with nullable desired_token and optional extensible actual. Includes published mission definitions. More than 1,000 supplied names returns desired-batch-limit. This raw route is outside generated client-v0 schemas.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or declaration selection rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Additive API and subject desired CLI subcommand; existing desired reads and subject cards are unchanged. Missing summary fields require fetching the card, not interpreting them as negative observations.

recovery.detail: Older daemons do not expose the batch route; existing per-subject desired and card reads remain available.
